slots.noteZh: 原装 DualSense，双人同玩可以多备一支。
slots.noteEn: Official DualSense; grab a second one for co-op nights.

slots.noteZh: OLED 画面，大场景更出彩。
slots.noteEn: OLED picture makes big open-world scenes pop.

slots.noteZh: PS5 可加装 M.2 固态扩容，选带散热片的款式。
slots.noteEn: The PS5 takes an M.2 SSD for extra storage; pick one with a heatsink.

slots.noteZh: 大型更新包和联机都吃网速，Mesh 补全家里的死角。
slots.noteEn: Big downloads and online play need a solid connection; mesh fills the dead spots.

slots.noteZh: 通宵开黑的小零食，空气炸锅搞定。
slots.noteEn: Late-night snacks, handled by an air fryer.

slots.noteZh: 手柄放上去就充电，不用来回找线。
slots.noteEn: Rest the controller on it and it charges; no more hunting for cables.

slots.noteZh: 电视背后的氛围灯，这款适用 65 寸以上的电视。
slots.noteEn: Backlight strip for behind the TV; this one fits 65" and larger.
